description_json.name: Vigenere Cipher with Fixed Keyword
description_json.idea: A polyalphabetic substitution cipher using a fixed internal keyword 'CIPHER'. The shift value changes for each letter based on the corresponding letter of the keyword, repeating the keyword as necessary. Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Use the fixed keyword 'CIPHER' (length 6).
2. Maintain a counter for alphabetic characters to determine the keyword letter index: index = counter % 6.
3. For each uppercase letter, shift it forward in the alphabet by the value of the keyword letter at the current index (A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25). For example, 'C' shifts by 2, 'I' by 8, 'P' by 15, 'H' by 7, 'E' by 4, 'R' by 17. Wrap around the alphabet using modulo 26.
4. For each lowercase letter, apply the same shift value based on the keyword letter, preserving lowercase casing.
5. Increment the counter only when an alphabetic character (A-Z, a-z) is processed.
6. Leave spaces, punctuation, digits, and all other non-alphabetic characters completely unchanged without incrementing the keyword counter.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. Use the fixed keyword 'CIPHER' (length 6).
2. Maintain a counter for alphabetic characters to determine the keyword letter index: index = counter % 6.
3. For each uppercase letter, shift it backward in the alphabet by the value of the keyword letter at the current index (A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25). Wrap around the alphabet using modulo 26.
4. For each lowercase letter, apply the same backward shift value, preserving lowercase casing.
5. Increment the counter only when an alphabetic character (A-Z, a-z) is processed.
6. Leave spaces, punctuation, digits, and all other non-alphabetic characters completely unchanged without incrementing the keyword counter.

description_json.name: QWERTY monoalphabetic substitution cipher
description_json.idea: A fixed one-to-one substitution over the English alphabet. Each plaintext letter is replaced by exactly one ciphertext letter using a single bijection, and the mapping is the same for uppercase and lowercase letters. Non-letter characters are left unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: Use the following bijection: plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -> ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm. Thus a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t, f->y, g->u, h->i, i->o, j->p, k->a, l->s, m->d, n->f, o->g, p->h, q->j, r->k, s->l, t->z, u->x, v->c, w->v, x->b, y->n, z->m. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Use the inverse bijection: ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm -> plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz. Thus q->a, w->b, e->c, r->d, t->e, y->f, u->g, i->h, o->i, p->j, a->k, s->l, d->m, f->n, g->o, h->p, j->q, k->r, l->s, z->t, x->u, c->v, v->w, b->x, n->y, m->z. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
